args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 (deployed to all production regions) was failing health checks with an 18% error rate. Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release, v2.3.0, in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rollback completed successfully; monitoring continues.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

## Actions taken

1. **Investigated** — `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), unhealthy with an 18% error rate. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the latest production deploy and unhealthy, while v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production.

2. **Rolled back** — Rolled `checkout-api` back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions. The rollback completed successfully (`rolled_out`).

3. **Opened incident** — Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0"), which paged the on-call engineer, documenting the failure and the rollback.

4. **Verified** — Post-rollback status confirms `checkout-api` is now on v2.3.0 in all regions, **healthy** with a 0.2% error rate.

Note: v2.3.1 remains the current unhealthy release; the incident is open so the on-call engineer can investigate the root cause before any re-deploy.
